title: PokeLabyrinth - a co-op Pokemon MMO-lite where you dive a bottomless well with friends (free, browser + mobile) [BETA]
author: Riolutail
selftext:
Hi everyone, this is PokéLabyrinth, a solo project inspired by Mystery Dungeon, Made in Abyss, and DanMachi. It's set in Lastlight, a town on the rim of the Starwell (a pit nobody has found the bottom of), and you go down it as your Pokémon and with up to 3 friends.

[https://pokelabyrinth.com/](https://pokelabyrinth.com/)

**On AI**: I used AI coding tools to build systems that would otherwise be way out of scope for one person (only a fraction of which is shown below). The design, story, art direction and music direction are mine. 

**Art**: the town, UI, environments and effects are all drawn in one pixel-art style. Pokémon sprites are from PMD SpriteCollab (full credits to them, their work is incredible).

Below is a quick bit at each part (among many others):

**Lastlight**

A town built down a slope in terraces, which experiences daytime at the top by the Well, sunset in the middle and night at the bottom. The townsfolk have their own routines and chat as you walk by. It's also where everyone hangs out between dives, so you'll run into other players at the shops and at Jirachi's wishing stall (99% quit before hitting it big?).

![gif](vlvew3qfl1zh1 "strolling through lastlight")

A short personality quiz picks your Pokémon, and you become it in PokéLabyrinth for good.

![gif](ic490fm0l1zh1 "mystery dungeon style character matching")

**Going down**

You ride the basket lift off the pier with your party to explore the Starwell, each layer offering its unique hazards you have to play around. The Lanternwood layer is the first one where the lights go out. The rest I'll leave for you to discover.

You ride the basket lift off the pier with your party to explore the Starwell, each layer offering its unique hazards you have to play around. The point of going down is relics, old stuff left behind by whoever lived down there before. They serve as your primary income source, and the deeper you go the older and more valuable they get, from copper coins near the top to crowns near the bottom. The Lanternwood layer is the first one where the lights go out. The rest I’ll leave for you to discover.

![gif](37igln04l1zh1 "exploring lanternwood")

**Combat**

It's action combat, real-time and top-down, and built to feel dynamic

![gif](oa518o04l1zh1 "combat snippets")

**Limitless Build Diversity - TM fusion and Gear Upgrades**

Whatever relics you carry home you can sell for gold or refine into gear or TM discs at Gholdengo’s Vault, so every run feeds your build.

At Genesect’s burner you put two discs into the fire and get a new move out (very similar to Infinite Craft if you’ve played that before). If nobody has made that move before, it’s a First Discovery and your name goes on it. Genesect also keeps the Archive, a wall of every move anyone on the server has made, where you can look up what it was fused from and what it goes into next.

At Tinkaton’s Starforge you upgrade your gear’s quality and rank by feeding it duplicates, which gives you a reason to go back down for more.

Infinite combinations, infinite builds to try in the Starwell.

And for those interested, I am using the llama model family via Novita AI for the disk combination names - the rolled effects for each combined disc, however is algorithmic. 

![gif](r7j44o04l1zh1 "fusing tms infinite craft style")

![gif](vimmkdm0l1zh1 "upgrading you gear")

![img](vnwnmdm0l1zh1 "perusing the archive")

**Co-op and the MMO-lite part**

Dives are co-op for up to 4. You can also start an Explorer Team, rent a house from the Guild, trade with other players at Porygon-Z’s terminal, and help the Guild rebuild Lastlight.

![gif](1vpyto04l1zh1 "coop dives")

![gif](1wf26em0l1zh1 "renting a guild house for your team")

![gif](cm2ufem0l1zh1 "trading player gear and cosmetics")

![gif](pfs9ifm0l1zh1 "guild quest board with quests, dailies, and leaderboards")

**Immersion UI mode**

The HUD and UI overlay can be switched off for a more cinematic experience (Settings → Advanced → Immersion mode). These gifs and trailer shots were filmed in-game using this mode.

https://i.redd.it/vddkrr04l1zh1.gif

**Past the last layer**

There's an endgame called the Hollow (fully coded), and that's all I'll say on it for now, since I think it'll be more fun for folks to find out more themselves.

https://i.redd.it/xn1jjn04l1zh1.gif

**Soundtrack**: all original and [uploaded](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLLt3zidjG4AA) onto YouTube as of today.

**Beta**: progress will be reset once before full launch, and everyone who plays the beta keeps a beta title through the reset as a thank you.

Any and all feedback is immensely appreciated, especially anything confusing or anything that feels unfair. If anything seems off or broken please let me know. Come say hi or report bugs on the [discord](https://discord.gg/3cRjpzYPR7).

Good luck out there and happy to answer any questions!
